name: @justybase/spreadsheet-tasks
description: High-performance TypeScript library for reading and writing Excel files in XLSB and XLSX formats. XLSB is 3.3x faster to write and 2.3x faster to read than XLSX.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:dist
scripts.test:unit: npx ts-node tests/unit/bigbuffer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/biff-reader-writer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/xlsb-writer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/excel-converter.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/updater-streaming.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/xlsx-reader-cell-refs.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/writer-limits-columns.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/reader-xml-fixes.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/xlsb-sst-dim.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/updater-cleanup.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/oa-1900-leap.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/unit/reader-row-limit.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsb-writer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsx-writer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsx-updater.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsb-updater.test.ts
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && npx ts-node tests/dist-surface.test.ts
scripts.test:excel-conversion: npm run build && npx ts-node tests/excel-compat/conversion.ts
scripts.test:xlsb: npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsb-writer.test.ts && npx ts-node tests/integration/xlsb-updater.test.ts
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && npx ts-node benchmarks/performance.bench.ts
scripts.benchmark:comparison: npm run build && npx ts-node benchmarks/comparison.bench.ts
scripts.test:excel-compat: npm run build && npx tsx tests/excel-compat/run.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:browser && npm test

author: Krzysztof Dusko
